none: No turntable yet. Add one and measure it with the test record.
form_hint: Step 1 of 5. Then the wizard measures the turntable with the AAPT 1 test record. The values then apply to all recordings with this turntable.
name: Name (required)
fixed_gain: Level not adjustable on the device (USB turntable with a fixed preamp)
fixed_gain_hint: Then the “check the gain on the interface” hints and the warning about clipping at stylus drop are left out. Clipping in the groove is still reported.
targets_hint: Target values depend on stylus and cartridge (channel separation, balance, wow & flutter). Edit maps: Settings → Targets.
no_device: no device found: connect the turntable via USB
select_or_add: Select or add a turntable on the left.
cal_text: Switch on the turntable, platter spinning, stylus stays up. The app records 25 seconds and stops by itself. This measures the self-noise of the turntable electronics and the recording.
side1_content: Contains reference tone, crosstalk (azimuth), frequency response, VTA and wow & flutter.
side2_content: Contains anti-skating ramp, pink noise, resonance and silent groove.
side_go: After the start, GO appears: then place the stylus at the start of the side. The recording stops by itself in the run-out groove; the analysis then runs automatically (about 1–2 minutes).
accept_title: Step 5: Review and accept the result
accept_text: The findings of both sides are below. If something is out of range (anti-skating, azimuth, speed), it is worth adjusting that first and recording the affected side again. Otherwise accept: from then on the app evaluates all recordings with this turntable using these values.
trims_title: How the app evaluates this turntable
ref_level_hint: 1 kHz, 5 cm/s. Pops count relative to this level (instead of a fixed −20 dBFS), so loud and quiet turntables are rated the same.
speed_hint: Skip detection looks for the true revolution period.
floor_hint: What the detector finds in the silent groove of the test record (side 2): stylus, cartridge and record of this chain. Record sides are rated with this floor subtracted.
floor_missing: Re-analyze side 2 of the accepted run to fill it in.
sensitivity_hint: One control for the detector: 0.3 finds only the obvious, 0.7 is aggressive. Applies to all recordings with this turntable; after a change the turntable floor is measured again.
device_missing: Device {device} is not connected. Recordings with this turntable only start once it is connected via USB.
remeasure_running: new measurement in progress, the previous values still apply
go_calibration: Leave the stylus up; the recording stops by itself after 25 s.
go_side: Place the stylus at the start of the side now. The recording stops by itself in the run-out groove.
confirm_delete: Delete turntable “{name}”? Recordings and alignment runs are kept, just without an assignment.
toast_go: GO: stylus to the start of the side
toast_accepted: Accepted: the app now evaluates with these values
